channel.description:
confluyo yo explores the raw, timbral and rhythmic relationships between intentional sounds, natural sounds, and sounds as byproduct of human activity. in the piece, a horn player plays short 9 second themes called 'seeds' and improvises over them. the seeds are repeated for the rest of the piece, though, through repetition, a generative model slowly "dematerializes" or transfers the timbral characteristics of the saxophone to the sound of birds, or the sound of machines.

watch the videos and read more: https://hugo-does-things.notion.site/confluyo-yo-el-ambiente-me-sigue-38a1b1073a1643a5b2ad0902a02daba7
